prompts: Reconcile {WS}/backoffice/invoices.csv with {WS}/backoffice/bank_statement_june.csv (the memo cites the invoice in different formats; ignore fees, interest and PIX transfers without an identifiable invoice). Write {WS}/reconciliation.json with unpaid (ids without payment), duplicated (ids paid more than once) and mismatched (list of objects id, invoiced, paid when the paid amount differs). Categories are exclusive: a duplicated invoice is NOT also mismatched. For mismatched, compare a single payment with its invoice. Write your files inside {WS}. Do not ask for confirmation.
